chunk_map.heading: Write it down or lose it
The agent stops where you stop writing
A list of don'ts does not teach good work
Change the rules on recurrence, not one miss

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: expanded view slide 2 'like this one' inside a quoted example; the quote's own gloss gives the example in the same sentence and the slide file owns its wording. 'digest' (slide 2 and 3) is ordinary noun of the training, the digest is named on slide 2 before slide 3 reuses it. Raw L5 and L7 include lines.
Closest: slide 3 'W. Edwards Deming called...' names a person, not a file by position; no 'the opening lecture' style pointers (grep of expanded body for 'lecture|module|earlier' returns none).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw' backward references to a beat

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: slide 1 third paragraph 'The line never disappears... Finding it is the work.' still carries a claim (the line is permanent); no chunk is a wait-state.
Closest: chunk 3 header 'Change the rules on recurrence, not one miss' vs body 'One wrong line in one digest is worth a note. It is not yet a reason to change the rules.' - body confirms the header.

Closest: chunk 1 'What is written, it can act on. What is still in your heads, it cannot.' is a contrast pair, not 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; chunk 3 'It is not yet a reason' is single negation. No triples, no superlatives, no verb triplets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: 'tampering' (Deming term, bolded, defined in sentence) and 'signal'; both ordinary engineering/quality vocabulary, no repo dialect (surface, compendium, beat, mood). Grep for forbidden dialect in body view: zero.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 3 one bolded handle 'tampering' (1 word); chunks 1 and 2 carry no bold. Within budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture is three standalone [Title](slides/<id>.md) include lines at raw L3, L5, L7; expand-md inlines all three as slide-file blocks, so each reaches the deck as its own ## chunk.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase N / numbered step headers; node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file -> OK

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/lectures/apt101-write-it-down-or-lose-it.md -> 'OK - 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.'

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no in-body links; only structural include links, which are out of scope

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture headings are claims: 'The agent stops where you stop writing', 'A list of don'ts does not teach good work', 'Change the rules on recurrence, not one miss'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 1 final paragraph 'The line never disappears. There is always something your team knows and has not yet said. Finding it is the work.' - borders on an aphorism kicker but adds the new claim that the line is permanent, not a restatement of the header. Chunk 2 closing paragraph adds a concrete move (keep exemplars in the rules).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no retitle trigger; no provenance note of the 'from <old-file>, header his' shape in the maintainer block
